results.note: Netty's readHeaders splits each header line as it reads it (splitHeader: `No colon found`), but adds the header (validating it) only when it reads the next line; strict line parsing fails a line ended by a bare LF as it is read. So a split error on the line before a bare-LF line wins, the pending header is never added, nor are the continuation lines folded into it
no colon on the line before a bare-LF header line
no colon on the line before a bare-LF blank line
no colon on the first header line
a first header line starting with a space is split too (no header to fold it into)
a continuation line is folded, not split: the LF fault, and the pending A is never added
the same on a connection's second request: logged once
